Eve (Support): FYI - ACME (PO-5542) says their procurement system requires prepaid on the PO but account team agreed to net45. Invoice INV-9987 is on hold. Can finance/ops advise?
Aisha (Account Exec): I approved net45 for them last month. I have the signed amendment. Procurement sent PO with Prepay=Y by mistake. I asked them to re-issue but procurement is slow.
Liam (Finance): Need evidence of the amendment + the PO PDF. If procurement won't amend quickly we can consider provisional credit. How high is the risk?
Kelsey (Support-Sr): Billing system shows hold reason: PO mismatch. Also VAT ID missing on the invoice metadata which can block bookkeeping in EU. @Aisha can you attach the PO and SOW? :thinking_face:
Aisha (Account Exec): attaching: PO-5542.pdf and SOW_signed_2026-02-14.pdf (sent via email to procurement, cc'ing legal). Procurement thread is slow.
BillingBot: [automated] Invoice INV-9987: status=ON_HOLD; hold_reasons=[PO_MISMATCH, VAT_MISSING]; customer_contact=procurement@acme.com
Marcus (Legal): If SOW is signed and terms show net45, we can approve provisional credit under the commercial playbook. Need a written procurement acknowledgment or a 1-line approval from legal to finance.
Eve (Support): Steps we need: 1) copy of PO + SOW, 2) confirmation from AE that net45 was accepted, 3) finance approval for provisional credit OR PO amendment. Who can action finance approval now?
Liam (Finance): I can approve provisional credit up to $45k for a verified contract. Send docs to finance@redwood.com with subject INV-9987 PENDING CREDIT. I need the scanned PO and SOW, and a note that procurement will reissue PO.
Kelsey (Support-Sr): To help the customer, I created ticket FIN-4523 and added invoice metadata. CLI snippet for internal audit:
```
{
  "invoice": "INV-9987",
  "po": "PO-5542",
  "amount": "30250.00",
  "currency": "EUR",
  "vat_id": "MISSING",
  "hold_reasons": ["PO_MISMATCH","VAT_MISSING"]
}
```
Aisha (Account Exec): Procurement replied: "we can reissue in 5-7 business days" but payment is due earlier. They requested evidence that net45 was agreed. I'll forward the amendment email.
BillingBot: [automated] Payment attempt: card on file declined (3 attempts). decline_code=487. Last_attempt=1998765438
Liam (Finance): Card decline + PO mismatch = we shouldn't auto-charge. Provisional credit is the safer path so customer can remain operational while procurement fixes PO. I'll put a hold waiver pending docs.
Marcus (Legal): Please include this clause in the provisional credit memo: "provisional credit contingent on procurement reissuing PO with equivalent terms within 10 business days; otherwise reversal." I can draft the memo.
Eve (Support): OK - summary: AE to send amendment and procurement email into finance@redwood.com, Legal to draft provisional credit memo, Finance to apply provisional credit hold waiver on FIN-4523, Support to monitor card attempts and pause retries. I'll mark this P1 and keep thread updated. :white_check_mark:
